name: dist_uniform_int_cdf
description:
P(X <= x) for the inclusive integer support `[min, max]`. For integers inside the support this is `(x - min + 1) / (max - min + 1)`.

This describes the corrected `v1.5` source dated October 7, 2026. Older community builds (including `234c881`) have incorrect continuous-uniform analytics and truncated BIGINT moments. Bounds remain DOUBLE arguments but must be finite BIGINT-valued integers with min <= max.

name: dist_uniform_int_cdf_complement
description:
P(X > x) for the inclusive integer support, computed directly for the upper tail.

This describes the corrected `v1.5` source dated October 7, 2026. Older community builds (including `234c881`) have incorrect continuous-uniform analytics and truncated BIGINT moments. Bounds remain DOUBLE arguments but must be finite BIGINT-valued integers with min <= max.

name: dist_uniform_int_chf
description:
Cumulative hazard `-ln(P(X > x))`. Returns positive infinity at or above max.

This describes the corrected `v1.5` source dated October 7, 2026. Older community builds (including `234c881`) have incorrect continuous-uniform analytics and truncated BIGINT moments. Bounds remain DOUBLE arguments but must be finite BIGINT-valued integers with min <= max.

name: dist_uniform_int_hazard
description:
Discrete hazard P(X = x) / P(X >= x). Returns 0 below min and 1 at max; undefined above max (raises an error).

This describes the corrected `v1.5` source dated October 7, 2026. Older community builds (including `234c881`) have incorrect continuous-uniform analytics and truncated BIGINT moments. Bounds remain DOUBLE arguments but must be finite BIGINT-valued integers with min <= max.

name: dist_uniform_int_kurtosis
description:
Kurtosis of the inclusive discrete uniform distribution. Undefined for equal bounds (zero variance).

This describes the corrected `v1.5` source dated October 7, 2026. Older community builds (including `234c881`) have incorrect continuous-uniform analytics and truncated BIGINT moments. Bounds remain DOUBLE arguments but must be finite BIGINT-valued integers with min <= max.

name: dist_uniform_int_kurtosis_excess
description:
Excess kurtosis of the inclusive discrete uniform distribution. Undefined for equal bounds (zero variance).

This describes the corrected `v1.5` source dated October 7, 2026. Older community builds (including `234c881`) have incorrect continuous-uniform analytics and truncated BIGINT moments. Bounds remain DOUBLE arguments but must be finite BIGINT-valued integers with min <= max.

name: dist_uniform_int_log_pdf
description:
Natural logarithm of the discrete probability mass. Outside the inclusive integer support, returns negative infinity.

This describes the corrected `v1.5` source dated October 7, 2026. Older community builds (including `234c881`) have incorrect continuous-uniform analytics and truncated BIGINT moments. Bounds remain DOUBLE arguments but must be finite BIGINT-valued integers with min <= max.

name: dist_uniform_int_mean
description:
Mean of the inclusive discrete uniform distribution: `(min + max) / 2`, returned as DOUBLE.

This describes the corrected `v1.5` source dated October 7, 2026. Older community builds (including `234c881`) have incorrect continuous-uniform analytics and truncated BIGINT moments. Bounds remain DOUBLE arguments but must be finite BIGINT-valued integers with min <= max.

name: dist_uniform_int_median
description:
Midpoint `(min + max) / 2`, returned as DOUBLE. With an even number of outcomes this can be fractional; `_quantile(..., 0.5)` returns the lower central integer.

This describes the corrected `v1.5` source dated October 7, 2026. Older community builds (including `234c881`) have incorrect continuous-uniform analytics and truncated BIGINT moments. Bounds remain DOUBLE arguments but must be finite BIGINT-valued integers with min <= max.

name: dist_uniform_int_mode
description:
Returns min as a representative mode. Every integer in the inclusive support has the same probability mass.

This describes the corrected `v1.5` source dated October 7, 2026. Older community builds (including `234c881`) have incorrect continuous-uniform analytics and truncated BIGINT moments. Bounds remain DOUBLE arguments but must be finite BIGINT-valued integers with min <= max.

name: dist_uniform_int_pdf
description:
Probability mass P(X = x) on the inclusive integer support `[min, max]`: `1 / (max - min + 1)` inside the support and 0 outside.

This describes the corrected `v1.5` source dated October 7, 2026. Older community builds (including `234c881`) have incorrect continuous-uniform analytics and truncated BIGINT moments. Bounds remain DOUBLE arguments but must be finite BIGINT-valued integers with min <= max.

name: dist_uniform_int_quantile
description:
Smallest supported integer whose CDF is at least p. At p = 0 returns min; at p = 1 returns max. The probability must be finite and between 0 and 1.

This describes the corrected `v1.5` source dated October 7, 2026. Older community builds (including `234c881`) have incorrect continuous-uniform analytics and truncated BIGINT moments. Bounds remain DOUBLE arguments but must be finite BIGINT-valued integers with min <= max. The probability uses its exact binary DOUBLE value, without epsilon snapping at probability-mass boundaries.

name: dist_uniform_int_quantile_complement
description:
Smallest supported integer whose upper-tail probability P(X > x) is at most p. At p = 0 returns max; at p = 1 returns min.

This describes the corrected `v1.5` source dated October 7, 2026. Older community builds (including `234c881`) have incorrect continuous-uniform analytics and truncated BIGINT moments. Bounds remain DOUBLE arguments but must be finite BIGINT-valued integers with min <= max. The probability uses its exact binary DOUBLE value, without epsilon snapping at probability-mass boundaries.

name: dist_uniform_int_skewness
description:
Returns 0 for a nondegenerate discrete uniform distribution. Undefined for equal bounds (zero variance).

This describes the corrected `v1.5` source dated October 7, 2026. Older community builds (including `234c881`) have incorrect continuous-uniform analytics and truncated BIGINT moments. Bounds remain DOUBLE arguments but must be finite BIGINT-valued integers with min <= max.

name: dist_uniform_int_stddev
description:
Square root of the discrete uniform variance, returned as DOUBLE.

This describes the corrected `v1.5` source dated October 7, 2026. Older community builds (including `234c881`) have incorrect continuous-uniform analytics and truncated BIGINT moments. Bounds remain DOUBLE arguments but must be finite BIGINT-valued integers with min <= max.

name: dist_uniform_int_variance
description:
Variance of the inclusive discrete uniform distribution: `((max - min + 1)^2 - 1) / 12`, returned as DOUBLE.

This describes the corrected `v1.5` source dated October 7, 2026. Older community builds (including `234c881`) have incorrect continuous-uniform analytics and truncated BIGINT moments. Bounds remain DOUBLE arguments but must be finite BIGINT-valued integers with min <= max.
